domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以矩阵形式表征车辆与轨道间轮轨接触关系的对象。
usage_overview: 用于把轮轨接触作用接入车辆与轨道的整体动力方程，纳入接触协调、蠕滑、等效刚度及不平顺输入；矩阵可随车辆位置和接触状态变化，以反映运动过程中的耦合关系。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P039.title: Numerical simulation platform for slab track systems subjected to a moving vehicle
P039.authors: L Xu, Z Li, W Bai, L Pan, Z Yu
P039.label: Xu等（2021）

complete_examples.text: Based on previous studies, the formulation of slab track dynamics in the framework of finite element theory is founded with simplicities, and then the wheel-rail coupling matrices totally derived from the nonlinear wheel-rail normal contact/tangential creep forces using the energy variation method are presented.
Essentially, the key to achieve the coupled analysis between the vehicle and the tracks is deriving the wheel-rail coupling matrices.
